grandparents_cupboard.reason: Plain Greek yoghurt, garlic, fresh herbs, lemon, olive oil and raw garden vegetables are all things a grandparent would have kept.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a grater, a sieve, a bowl and a knife, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: Half a salted, squeezed cucumber in 300g yoghurt with plenty of veg for dipping makes a well-balanced snack for four.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes covers grating, chopping herbs and cutting batons, and the 10 minutes matches the unattended salting in the sieve.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A cool cucumber dip with fresh garden veg suits mid-July, and the cucumber is both the dip and a crudité.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and plainly British, and crudités is a familiar word to home cooks.

hearty_healthy.reason: Yoghurt and a big plate of raw vegetables make a wholesome snack a family would happily eat again.
